$d=T_{3}-T_{2}=(12)-(10)=2$ and $d=T_{4}-T_{3}=(14)-(12)=2$. All of the results are the same, so 2 tiles are added each time.
Picture 5 uses $14+2=16$ tiles.
Picture 6 uses $16+2=18$ tiles.
Picture 6 will use $18$ tiles.
